title: 即時編譯與程式最佳化
summary: 以最佳化合法性、JIT 編譯與去最佳化連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect optimization legality, jit compilation and deoptimization through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 執行時編譯契約
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「執行時編譯契約」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop runtime compilation contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: JIT 與 AOT：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: JIT and AOT: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「JIT 與 AOT」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for jit and aot.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「JIT 與 AOT」的資料、控制與時間關係。編譯時間位置與可用資訊不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較啟動與穩態成本。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for jit and aot. Compilation timing and available information differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare startup and steady costs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測例相同就可忽略最佳化的副作用語義。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Matching tests permit ignoring side-effect semantics. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「JIT 與 AOT」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「編譯時間位置與可用資訊不同。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit jit and aot two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: JIT 與 AOT的原理與邊界
knowledge.titleEn: JIT and AOT principle and boundaries
knowledge.text: 編譯時間位置與可用資訊不同。
knowledge.textEn: Compilation timing and available information differ.

knowledge.title: JIT 與 AOT的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較啟動與穩態成本。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare startup and steady costs. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設編譯成本 40 ms，每次執行由 1.0 ms 降至 0.6 ms，節省 0.4 ms/call，回本次數=40/0.4=100 calls。未含暖機、profiling、記憶體及去最佳化；少於 100 次可能較慢。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 40 ms compilation and execution reduced from 1.0 to 0.6 ms/call. Break-even=40/0.4=100 calls, excluding warmup, profiling, memory and deoptimization; fewer calls may be slower.

quiz.question: 本步審查「JIT 與 AOT」與整體「即時編譯與程式最佳化」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing jit and aot within just-in-time compilation and optimization, which statement or check is supported?
options: 編譯時間位置與可用資訊不同。
測例相同就可忽略最佳化的副作用語義。
每個函式高成本最佳化必定降低總耗時。
optionsEn: Compilation timing and available information differ.
Matching tests permit ignoring side-effect semantics.
Expensive optimization always reduces total time.
quiz.explanation: 編譯時間位置與可用資訊不同。 比較啟動與穩態成本。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Compilation timing and available information differ. Compare startup and steady costs. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: JIT 與 AOT：實驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: JIT and AOT: experiment and validation
steps.objective: 用「比較啟動與穩態成本。」檢查「JIT 與 AOT」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for jit and aot using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「JIT 與 AOT」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較啟動與穩態成本。 核對「編譯時間位置與可用資訊不同。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for jit and aot and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare startup and steady costs. Check the principle: Compilation timing and available information differ. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測例相同就可忽略最佳化的副作用語義。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Matching tests permit ignoring side-effect semantics. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「JIT 與 AOT」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較啟動與穩態成本。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit jit and aot input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.title: Profile 資料：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「Profile 資料」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for profile data.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Profile 資料」的資料、控制與時間關係。過去熱門路徑不能保證未來相同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較訓練與驗收工作負載。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for profile data. Past hot paths do not guarantee future behavior. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare profiling and acceptance workloads. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較訓練與驗收工作負載。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個函式高成本最佳化必定降低總耗時。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Expensive optimization always reduces total time. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「Profile 資料」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「過去熱門路徑不能保證未來相同。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit profile data two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.textEn: Compare profiling and acceptance workloads. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

steps.title: Profile 資料：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「比較訓練與驗收工作負載。」檢查「Profile 資料」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for profile data using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「Profile 資料」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較訓練與驗收工作負載。 核對「過去熱門路徑不能保證未來相同。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for profile data and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare profiling and acceptance workloads. Check the principle: Past hot paths do not guarantee future behavior. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較訓練與驗收工作負載。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個函式高成本最佳化必定降低總耗時。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Expensive optimization always reduces total time. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「Profile 資料」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較訓練與驗收工作負載。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit profile data input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
